note: THE KINGDOM'S HELP -- the Kingdom tab's HELP sub-tab (scenes/kingdom/help_section.gd): the day's shared goal and the calls for aid. The section is built in code, as LORDS, WORKS and RANKS are (kingdom_section.gd), so what is cut here are the painting's own objects at their painted sizes and not a page template. The two panels themselves are the kit's card frame (inventory/card_frame), which is what LORDS, WORKS and RANKS already stand in on this tab -- the painting's gold-cornered frame cannot be lifted off its own contents, and two frames on one tab would be two looks. A lord's face in an aid row is portraits/avatar_<id>_ring with their own frame over it, the same object the hall and the medallions draw.

crops.name: help/title_goal
crops.note: TODAY'S GOAL, the words baked: the goal's KIND changes (hands to the work, swords of the realm) and is set in type under this, but what the panel is never changes.

crops.name: help/goal_scene
crops.note: The kingdom raising its banner: the goal's own picture, whichever goal the day asks for. There is one scene because there is one goal a day -- a second painting for the second kind would be a second thing to keep true.

crops.name: help/bar_track
crops.note: The bar the day's work fills, cut from the stretch the painting leaves EMPTY (x 686 on): the painted bar is two thirds full, and a track cut from the filled part would be a bar that starts full.

crops.name: help/bar_fill
crops.note: The gold that fills it, cut from the painting's own filled stretch and drawn to whatever width the kingdom has reached.

crops.name: help/knob
crops.note: The knob a chest sits on, on the bar.

crops.name: help/plate
crops.note: The small plate under a chest, for what it holds.

crops.name: help/share
crops.note: The share plate with its glyph baked: a kingdom telling its lords the goal is close.

crops.name: help/claim
crops.note: CLAIM, the word baked: it never changes. Dimmed while there is nothing to take.

crops.name: help/aid_scene
crops.note: The clasped gauntlets: what a call for aid is.

crops.name: help/stat_members
crops.note: The plate that says how many lords are standing, its figure of three baked as the icon it is.

crops.name: help/stat_energy
crops.note: The plate beside it, for what the aid is worth.

crops.name: help/hand
crops.note: The raised hand on its banner: the mark beside a lord who has asked and is still waiting.

crops.name: help/row_name
crops.note: The plate a lord's name is set on in an aid row.

crops.name: help/row_small
crops.note: The small plate beside it, for how many have answered.

crops.name: help/aid_button
crops.note: AID, baked. The word is the same on every row and never changes.

crops.name: help/ask
crops.note: ASK FOR AID, baked: the one thing a lord does for themselves on this page.
